sloka: इयं हि पूर्वैः सन्दिष्टा गतिः क्षत्रियसम्मता ।क्षत्रियो निहतः सङ्ख्ये न शोच्य इति निश्चय ।। ६.११२.१९ ।।
transliteration: iyaṁ hi pūrvaiḥ sandiṣṭā gatiḥ kṣatriyasammatā ।kṣatriyo nihataḥ saṅkhye na śocya iti niścaya ।। 6.112.19 ।।

translations.english: "This course has been practised in the past by ancient kings for those killed in war. Warrior killed in war is not to be mourned', is true."
